Prednisone for Poison Ivy
I was prescribed Prednisone for a Poison Ivy outbreak on the backs of my hands. I took the medicine as perscribed and felt no mental or physical side effects. I should mention that I am experienced with drugs like Ephedrine, LSD, MDMA, shrooms, 4-aco-dmt, etc. So I am very confident in my analysis. The Poison Ivy stopped itching and cleared up in a few days.
